outlier: Modo is a simple cross platform cli app that lets you interact with markdown style check boxes within any text file blazingly fast. Also supports the default vim bindings to navigate and filter through your todos.

recent_posts.title: StackRender V1.1.0 : Generate Database Migrations from ER Diagram Changes
recent_posts.summary: StackRender V1.1.0 introduces a visual-first approach to database migrations by generating production-ready migration scripts from ER diagram changes. The tool tracks diagram modifications over time and automatically creates UP/DOWN migration scripts, handling complex operations like proper column renames, ENUM modifications, and relationship changes. It supports PostgreSQL and MySQL, addressing limitations in traditional ORM-based migration tools that struggle with detecting certain schema changes accurately.

recent_posts.title: Reading Between the (reddit) Lines: Postman Changes and What Devs Value
recent_posts.summary: Developer sentiment analysis from Reddit discussions reveals six key priorities for API tools: git-native workflows with collections living alongside code, local-first architecture to avoid vendor lock-in, reliable import capabilities for OpenAPI and HAR formats, lightweight performance over feature bloat, seamless secrets handling through environment variables, and selective automation for testing. The core insight is that developers prioritize trust and workflow alignment over flashy features—favoring version control integration, local-first defaults, human-readable formats, and avoiding proprietary lock-in.

recent_posts.title: Postman announced that their Free plan for teams is going away.
recent_posts.summary: Postman is discontinuing its free team plan, limiting free accounts to single users only. This reflects a broader trend where API collaboration tools require paid seats for team features. Alternative approaches exist that leverage Git for API specification collaboration through Markdown files in repositories, enabling team workflows via commits and pull requests without per-seat pricing.

recent_posts.title: Built a 3D Scrollytelling Engine
recent_posts.summary: A visual studio tool that generates standalone 3D scrollytelling experiences without framework dependencies. Exports include a custom vanilla JavaScript engine (ScrollyPipeline.js), project configuration JSON, and assets bundled in a ZIP file. Features spline-based camera interpolation, real-time PBR materials, multi-chapter support, and configurable easing. Deployable to any static host without build processes or npm dependencies, with optional React integration via JSON export.

recent_posts.title: Free Valentina Studio 16 now available
recent_posts.summary: Valentina Studio 16 has been released as a free database management tool supporting major databases including PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL/MariaDB, MS SQL Server, SQLite, DuckDB, and ValentinaDB. The PRO version includes advanced diagramming, reporting, and forms creation capabilities similar to MS Access or FileMaker. A 5-connection version of Valentina Server 16 is also available for free.

recent_posts.title: Why be late, when Nityasha is here?
recent_posts.summary: Nityasha is an AI-powered personal assistant that integrates with Notion to streamline workflows through automated note management, task organization, research assistance, and image search capabilities.

recent_posts.title: Static is boring — animate your icons 🎯
recent_posts.summary: AnimateIcons is a React library that transforms static SVG icons into smooth animations. It offers 45+ animated icons, works with React and Next.js, supports hover and programmatic control, and integrates with ShadCN CLI. The library aims to enhance user interfaces by adding purposeful motion to icons.

recent_posts.title: Making system design diagrams less painful.
recent_posts.summary: A developer created Rapidchart, a free technical diagram generator designed to streamline and accelerate the process of creating system architecture diagrams, addressing the common pain points of manual diagramming.

recent_posts.title: Introducing Fluster: Rust powered academic note taking with integrated AI
recent_posts.summary: Fluster is a new open source note taking application built with Rust and Tauri, designed specifically for academic and research use. It supports MDX for embedding interactive components, includes features like bibliography management, local semantic search, AI chat capabilities, and task management. The application runs completely offline with local AI models and vector database, targeting students, academics, and developers who need advanced note taking functionality beyond basic markdown editors.

recent_posts.title: Chiko - TUI gRPC client
recent_posts.summary: Chiko is a Terminal User Interface client for gRPC that simplifies testing and interacting with gRPC services. Built with grpcurl and rivo's tview libraries, it provides an intuitive visual interface to overcome the complexity of remembering command-line flags and syntax when working with gRPC services.
